name: io.oaki.www/oaki
title: Oaki AI
description: Find live jobs that fit a resume, ranked by fit, with a reason and an apply link for each.

tools.name: find_jobs_for_resume
tools.description: Finds live jobs that fit a resume, from Oaki AI's index of jobs posted on company career sites. Use it when the user shares a resume and wants matching job openings. Input is the resume as plain text, plus optional country, US state or Canadian province, and remote-only filters. Returns up to 10 jobs ranked by fit, each with title, company, location, date posted, pay when the posting lists it, a fit score from 0 to 100, a short reason, and a link to apply on the employer's site. Read-only: it does not apply to jobs, create an account or store the resume; the name line and contact details are removed before matching. Limits: English-language resumes work best, results only include jobs in Oaki's index, and each address can run a few searches a minute.

resume_text.description: The full text of the resume (work history, skills, education). At least a few lines; contact details may be left out.

country.description: Two-letter code of the country to search. Leave it out to use the country written at the top of the resume; if the resume names none, every country in the index is searched.

region.description: Optional US state or Canadian province code to search in, for example "TX" for Austin or "ON" for Toronto; remote jobs are kept too. It sets the country to US or CA when country is left out. Cities are not supported, so pass the state or province.

remote_only.description: Set to true to return only remote jobs. Defaults to false.
